title: Homecoming
paragraphs: It’s the next day.
“Today, we’re planning to take a trip back to the village with Sadeena-san and the villagers.”
“Oh, understood. I don’t have any plans, so I’ll come along.”

I haven’t given up on finding my sister. Father and Older Sister continue to search, believing that she’s definitely alive somewhere. To strengthen that resolve, they’re probably taking everyone back to the village once.
“So, let’s pack some lunches and head out together.”

Father was using the castle’s kitchen to prepare food for everyone. It seems that a considerable amount of lunch was prepared. Some of the dishes were apparently made with the help of the village’s slaves. Father is still cooking in the kitchen. As we were getting ready to leave, Older Sister was cheering up the village’s slaves.
“I’m fully recovered!”
It seems that the slaves understood that Older Sister had recovered, and their previously gloomy expressions brightened. As expected, the influence that Older Sister has on everyone is immeasurable.
“We should also stop by the village where Imiya-chan’s relatives live later.”
“Ah… yes. I’ve heard that everyone’s doing well. I’m sure they’ll be happy if the Shield Hero visits.”
Mole was occasionally glancing at Older Sister.
“Oh? Imiya-chan, is something on your mind?”
“Uh, um…”
Mole seemed flustered and panicked. What’s the matter?
“I’m just glad you’re better.”
“Yeah! Thanks to Naofumi-chan, I was able to keep going.”
“Yes… I understand.”
“Oh, Imiya-chan too?”
“Yes.”
Mole looked down shyly, while Older Sister smiled happily.
“Then we’re comrades. Let’s do our best from now on.”
“Um… yes.”
“Imiya-chan, I’m looking forward to it, okay?”
“Eh? Uh…?”
Mole tilted her head at Older Sister’s words. Older Sister sometimes says things that don’t make sense. With that, we had Filolial-sama pull the carriage, and we headed to the village.

Thinking back, it’s the village that Father had developed in the first world, where I had been taken care of… I’d heard about it, but as expected, it seems to have become a deserted village. To think that Father developed such a ruined village in the first world… he truly is an amazing person. Slowly, we arrived at the deserted village and got off the carriage.

The square where the village’s slaves used to run around, Father’s house, Ren, Itsuki, and my house… the illusions of those places seemed to float before my eyes, but that was surely just my imagination. On the outskirts of the village, there was the hut where Filolial-sama used to live… the bioplant fields. Just remembering the differences makes me feel a little melancholic.

Father turned his gaze to the village’s slaves. Currently, Melromarc is still suffering from the scars left by the Three Heroes Church and the rampage of the Crimson Swine. I’ve heard that the contamination of the land still lingers. In this situation, where there are only a handful of villagers left, Mole’s village still has more people.
“Everyone, let’s go visit the graves.”
“Okay!”

I fully understood that this world was different from the first one. The Crimson Swine and the Three Heroes Church are nothing but a tremendous menace. Father and Older Sister gave the slaves the bouquets they had placed on the carriage and then offered them at what seemed to be a grave.
“Next is over here.”

Older Sister pointed to what looked like a grave built on a cliff along the coast and offered something with Father. We clasped our hands in prayer. It must be the graves of the people who originally lived in this village.
I felt as though a somber air was lingering. In the midst of that, Older Sister raised her hand.
“Okay, everyone, let’s eat the lunch Naofumi-chan prepared in a place with a nice view.”
“Yay!”

Filolial-sama and the slaves all nodded in agreement. Everyone began eating the lunch that Father had prepared, each enjoying it in their own way. The previously somber atmosphere seemed to have dissipated considerably.
“I was feeling a little suffocated. It wouldn’t be good for the villagers to come to the grave with such gloomy faces, right?”
“Well… moderation is necessary, though.”
Older Sister sat next to Father and looked at the village’s slaves. Then, she gave a gentle smile.
“It’s a very sad thing, but let’s move forward, okay? Because everyone who survived is still here.”
“Yeah!”
The cheerful atmosphere made even Filolial-sama let out joyful sounds. I was starting to feel cheerful as well.
“Now then, what should we do next?”
It seems the grave visit is over. Isn’t there nothing left to do but head back?
“Um… I’d like to look around the village a little longer.”
The slaves suggested this. Father and Older Sister nodded in response.
“You’re right. It would be a shame to leave so soon after arriving. How about taking a little time to look around the village freely?”
“Thank you very much.”
Is there something that caught their interest? The village’s slaves seemed to be asking in unison.
“Filolial-samas, please make sure these kids don’t get into any danger.”
“Okay!”
Since it’s an abandoned village, we don’t know what’s out there, and it would be a disaster if someone got hurt. We’ll need to keep a watchful eye.
“Maybe I’ll go check on my secret base while I can. I’ve hidden all sorts of things there.”
“Sadeena-san’s house?”
Older Sister pointed toward the sea.
“There’s an island a little way off the village. It’s my secret base.”

Come to think of it, Older Sister’s secret base was on a nearby island. I remember that Father had used that island as a base when he was burning with ambition to conquer the world in the first world.
“I also hid some rare alcohol there, so I’d like to bring it back. Do you think Naofumi-chan and Motoyasu-chan will come along?”
“But… will the kids be okay?”
Sensing Father’s concern, the slaves responded with a smile.
“We’ll be fine!”
“Hero-sama, please go with Sadeena-oneesan. She’s still recovering.”
“That’s right! With Filolial-samas here, we’ll be okay!”
“Yeah! Sakura will protect everyone!”
“Is that so? Then I’ll go out for a bit.”
“Alright, I’m off!”
“I’m coming too!”
“I’ll join as well!”
Yuki-chan seems to be coming along too.
“Well then, Naofumi-chan can ride on my back.”
“U-Understood.”
“Come now, Motoyasu-sama, please get on.”
“Understood, I’m ready!”

With that, Father, Yuki-chan, and I followed Older Sister as we headed toward the island where her secret base was located. The slaves, meanwhile, were reminiscing about the past in the abandoned village.
“This is my secret base.”

As Older Sister guided us, I looked around the island. Yes, this was the place where Father had once been invited in the first world. It’s a crescent-shaped island that seems to have a shallow coastline. It’s not that big. Quite a romantic island.

There seems to be a cave on one end of the crescent shape. And in the middle of the crescent, there’s a small grove. If this place was lit up at night, it would be full of atmosphere. It’s a perfect spot for a date with Filo-tan.
“It seems like a great place to visit at night.”
“Y-Yeah, you’re right.”
It seems Father was thinking the same thing as me.
“It’s a lovely island.”

Yuki-chan was gracefully swimming in the shallows. Oh… the clear water and white sandy beach reminded me of a tropical vacation where I was invited by that pig. I couldn’t care less about the pig, but this island rivals that experience.
“Wouldn’t it be a good idea to invite the Filolial-samas and the slaves from the village here?”
“That might be a good idea. It would be nice for everyone to enjoy a swim.”
“Yeah. If we’ve found such a hidden gem, maybe we should all enjoy it today. Grilling some fish with Motoyasu-kun’s fire magic would be delicious too.”
“Great idea. Naofumi-chan, can you help me bring out the alcohol and supplies from my secret base?”
“Of course.”
“Then I’ll look for something edible while I’m at it, and I’ll go call everyone.”
“Could I ask you to do that?”
“Leave it to me!”
I nodded in response to Father’s request.
